audit.summary: A current-release episode-boundary mask can ignore cached reset flags and reintroduce prior-episode attention values. The release also differs from the paper in KL clipping/weighting, imagination batch size and decoder channels. Public aggregate results remain supported; historical experiment binding and stronger causal claims need evidence.
